titleZh: 重塑校园消费习惯，共建可持续未来
titleEn: Reshaping Campus Consumption Habits for a Sustainable Future

sentences.english: In modern university life, rapid delivery services and convenient online shopping have transformed daily consumption patterns.
sentences.chinese: 在现代大学生活中，快捷的配送服务与便利的网络购物已经改变了日常消费模式。

sentences.english: However, excessive packaging and harmful plastic containers generate massive waste, placing heavy pressure on campus environments.
sentences.chinese: 然而，过度包装与有害塑料容器产生了大量垃圾，给校园环境带来了沉重压力。

sentences.english: Students must acknowledge these environmental challenges and adopt practical strategies to reduce daily waste.
sentences.chinese: 学生必须正视这些环境挑战，并采取切实可行的策略来减少日常浪费。

sentences.english: One effective approach is promoting durable items and encouraging students to participate in campus recycling programs.
sentences.chinese: 一种行之有效的方法是推广耐用物品，并鼓励学生参与校园回收计划。

sentences.english: Instead of throwing away textbooks, clothes, and electronic devices, students can exchange idle goods at second-hand markets.
sentences.chinese: 学生不必丢弃教材、衣物和电子设备，而是可以在二手市场上交换闲置物品。

sentences.english: Such practical initiatives conserve valuable resources and cultivate thrift among young consumers.
sentences.chinese: 这类务实的举措能够节约宝贵资源，并在年轻消费者中培养节俭意识。

sentences.english: Universities also play a vital role in guiding green behavior through clear policies and sufficient facilities.
sentences.chinese: 高校同样通过明确的政策与完善的设施，在引导绿色行为方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

sentences.english: When dining halls reward green habits and dormitories simplify garbage classification, sustainable choices become natural routines.
sentences.chinese: 当食堂奖励环保习惯、宿舍简化垃圾分类时，可持续的选择便会化作自然的日常惯例。

sentences.english: In the long run, combining individual awareness with institutional support will yield lasting ecological benefits.
sentences.chinese: 从长远来看，将个人意识与制度支持相结合，必将产生持久的生态效益。

expansionEntries.explanation: 采纳，欣然接受（注意区分 adapt 适应）
方法，途径（熟词僻义：n.途径）
熟词僻义：除“懒散的”外，常考“闲置的；空转的”
节约保护 / 保护维持 / 储备预订
熟词僻义：除“政策”外，商业阅读常考“保险单”
熟词僻义：v.产生（收益/结果）；让步；n.产量

titleZh: 在算法洪流中守护认知自主与深度阅读
titleEn: Safeguarding Cognitive Autonomy and Deep Reading in the Algorithmic Era

sentences.english: In an era dominated by algorithmic feeds, endless short videos and sensational headlines compete for human attention.
sentences.chinese: 在一个由算法信息流主导的时代，无穷无尽的短视频与耸人听闻的标题正竞相争夺人类的注意力。

sentences.english: This relentless stream of transient stimuli can erode patience and exacerbate mental fatigue among young readers.
sentences.chinese: 这种无休止的短暂刺激流会侵蚀耐心，并加剧年轻读者的精神疲惫。

sentences.english: Consequently, many individuals become vulnerable to superficial thinking and lose their capacity for rigorous scrutiny.
sentences.chinese: 因此，许多人容易陷入肤浅思考，并丧失严密审视与辨析的能力。

sentences.english: Researchers warn that habitual skimming at the expense of deep contemplation may hamper healthy neuroplasticity.
sentences.chinese: 研究人员警告称，以牺牲深度沉思为代价的习惯性略读，可能会阻碍健康的神经可塑性发展。

tokens.gloss: n.神经可塑性；脑回路重塑能力

sentences.english: Although instant summaries seem plausible routes, they often obscure intricate logic and subtle nuances within classic texts.
sentences.chinese: 尽管即时摘要看似是合乎情理的捷径，但它们往往会掩盖经典文本中错综复杂的逻辑与微妙差别。

sentences.english: To offset these inherent drawbacks, educators contend that universities must foster sustained intellectual engagement.
sentences.chinese: 为了抵消这些固有的弊端，教育工作者主张高校必须培养持久的智力投入。

sentences.english: Retrieving cognitive autonomy entails deliberate boundaries, such as setting daily thresholds for passive screen exposure.
sentences.chinese: 重获认知自主权需要有意识地划定边界，例如为被动屏幕接触设定每日上限。

sentences.english: Readers, in particular, should remain skeptical of biased echo chambers and strive to alleviate digital distraction.
sentences.chinese: 尤其是读者，更应对带有偏见的回音室保持怀疑态度，并努力缓解数字分心。

sentences.english: It is imperative to preserve quiet intervals so that genuine insight and creative thinking can prevail.
sentences.chinese: 必须保留宁静的独处间隙，以便真正的洞见与创造性思维能够占据上风。

expansionEntries.explanation: 熟词僻义：除“喂养”外，互联网语境常指“信息流，动态推送”

expansionEntries.expression: at the expense of/at the cost of

expansionEntries.explanation: 易混辨析：貌似有理的（常暗含未必真实，区别于 genuine）
熟词僻义：a.晦涩的；无名的；v.掩盖，使模糊不清
熟词僻义：后接宾语从句时意为“主张，坚称”（= maintain/argue）
熟词僻义：a.故意的；深思熟虑的；v.仔细权衡
